result.description:
MedicalJobsAustralia.com     Clinical Nurse - ICU - Education





Job no: 942501

Work type: Part time

Located in: Adelaide Metro Northern

Categories: Nursing-Midwifery




 

Northern Adelaide Local Health Network - ICU Clinical Nurse - Education Portfolio - Elizabeth Vale

Salary $90,913 - $114,917 p.a. - RN2C

Temporary Part-Time - 24 hours per week, up to 24 September 2027 

About the Role:

Lyell McEwin Hospital's Intensive Care Unit is a cornerstone of critical care in Adelaide's north - and right now, there's an opportunity for an experienced Clinical Nurse to join the team on a part-time, fixed-term contract through to 24 September 2027.

Your Role in Critical Care

Working within the Northern Adelaide Local Health Network (NALHN), you'll deliver high-quality, evidence-based nursing care to critically ill patients across a well-supported ICU environment. Key responsibilities include:

Providing direct, complex clinical care to ICU patients, including those requiring mechanical ventilation and haemodynamic monitoring

Collaborating with multidisciplinary teams to develop and implement individualised patient care plans

Contributing to quality improvement initiatives and supporting safe clinical practice standards

Mentoring and supporting colleagues and undergraduate nurses within the unit

What You Bring

Current registration as a Registered Nurse with the Australian Health Practitioner Regulation Agency (AHPRA)

Demonstrated ICU or critical care clinical experience in an acute hospital setting

Sound knowledge of advanced life support, ventilation management, and invasive monitoring

Ability to work effectively within a multidisciplinary team environment

Understanding of SA Health policies, procedures, and patient safety frameworks

Post-graduate qualification in critical care nursing, or active progress towards one, highly regarded

To be eligible for this position, you must be Registered or eligible for registration as a Nurse with the Nursing and Midwifery Board of Australia and who holds, or who is eligible to hold, a current practicing certificate.

About You:

You will be joining a dynamic and expanding Local Health Network that is committed to delivering contemporary, innovative and high-quality health services within modern facilities.

This is an excellent opportunity to contribute to a passionate, highly driven, dedicated and progressive team.

About Adelaide:

About Us:

The Northern Adelaide Local Health Network (NALHN) is a leading provider of public healthcare services in South Australia, and one of the largest employers in northern Adelaide. 

NALHN serves over 400,000 people in northern Adelaide with a comprehensive range of high-quality healthcare services, including emergency, surgical, obstetric, neonatal, paediatric, oncology, geriatric, palliative care and rehabilitation, and mental health care, as well as primary health care services with a focus on community health promotion and chronic disease management.

With a commitment for ongoing upgrades to our facilities and the introduction of new services, our priority is delivering exceptional health and wellbeing services that enhance the quality of life for our community.

With over 7,000 employees, NALHN emphasises quality care and a supportive work environment guided by respect, integrity, and accountability. Our core values foster excellence, innovation, and equitable health outcomes. 

At NALHN Everyone Has a Story, Everyone Matters, Everyone Contributes and Everyone Grows. 

Our Local Health Network Sites and Services:
